verdict.reasons: Core conditions hold: the image clearly displays the authoritative white and blue cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll with authentic, readable branding that matches the reference identity guide. The installed laterals are technically appropriate thin drip tapes suitable for the scene, and the presence of neutral small seedlings aligns perfectly with the article's agronomy focus. No mixed product families, people, or collage elements are present. The required legitimate watermark is correctly displayed. Minor advisory notes include the loose, un-deployed coiling of the lateral tape in the foreground, which is not standard for an installed demonstration, and minor visual overlap between the tape line and seedling, but these do not affect the core illustration quality or commercial accuracy.

focused_physical_review.reason: A distinct additional uninstalled black coil (drip irrigation tape) is visible resting on the soil surface immediately adjacent to the right side of the required AFP package; it is a separate object rather than an ordinary continuous installed lateral. A broad, uninterrupted gap of bare soil is visible around the full footprint of the white-and-blue package (front, left, and visible sides), with no irrigation lines crossing or touching the carton base. The carton sides and base are free of any visible protruding white ribbons, straps, or tape tails.
